theme: Medical Futurism / Apple-Level 3D Glow (Dark Mode Only)
concept: A genuinely elevated, high-end medical-tech aesthetic utilizing deep blacks, bioluminescent cyan and emerald holographic accents, and 'Crystal Variant' glassmorphism. Moving beyond standard gradients into a spatial, dimensional web experience using CSS layering and Framer Motion.

headings.style: Variable weight, tight tracking (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter).
headings.usage: Use for all main H1-H4 headings to create a bold, structural, editorial tech look.

mono.usage: Use for stats, counters, and technical 'AI' data points.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-12 for internal card padding, gap-8 to gap-12 for sections. Ensure high contrast and breathing room.
layouts.grids: Bento-style asymmetric layouts (Tetris Grid). Avoid boring 4x2 grids. Mix col-span-1 and col-span-2 cards for visual tension.
layouts.hero: Spatial depth. Instead of a basic 2D layout, center the hero with massive typography. Place a massive CSS-rendered or SVG 'Holographic' medical sphere/nodes behind the UI, rotating slowly with Framer Motion, blurred at the edges.
layouts.features: Bento Grid (md:grid-cols-3 or 4). Feature 1 (Clinical Case Solver) spans 2 columns. Others span 1. Use 'Tracing Beam' border effect on the primary feature.

motion.hover: Subtle scale (1.02) + border glow + inner element translation (e.g., icon shifts right 4px).
motion.background: Slow-moving glowing radial gradients using absolute positioning and CSS animations.

components.nav: Floating Crystal Nav at the top. Not full width. Max-w-5xl, rounded-full, mt-6. backdrop-blur-2xl.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped. bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 font-bold tracking-tight shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.3)].
buttons.secondary: Glass pill. border border-white/20 bg-white/5 text-white hover:bg-white/10.
buttons.pro: Moving gradient border, dark inner background, glowing cyan text.

components.cards: Holo-cards with 1px semi-transparent borders. Icons must be glowing (drop-shadow).
components.faq: Shadcn accordion, but customized: border-b border-white/10, no background. Plus icon rotates 45deg on open.

imagery.usage: Blend images with heavy black gradients (e.g., bg-black/60) so they act as texture, not flat photos.

urls.description: Abstract medical shapes, set to low opacity (10%) behind the main content.
Medical student studying in dark, use with heavy overlay.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over gradients maintains 4.5:1 ratio. Use text-shadow on text overlapping any glow.
accessibility.testing: All buttons, links, and forms must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-start-free-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use HTML native selects or datepickers. Use Shadcn.
Do NOT center-align paragraph text. Keep body text left-aligned for readability.
Avoid generic 'purple' AI slop. Stick to the Void Black + Bioluminescent Cyan/Emerald palette.
Implement the bento grids exactly as requested. Do NOT default to uniform 4x2 grids.
Use lucide-react for all standard icons, and framer-motion for all interactions.
DO NOT use generic transition: all. Target specific properties.
Ensure dark colors are not used as gradients.
